description.value: The Almer Carlson Outdoor Pool is a seasonal public swimming facility operated by the Fraser Valley Regional District as part of the Hope Recreation Complex. It is one of two recreation facilities run by the FVRD in the Hope area, serving residents and visitors with family-oriented aquatic programming during the summer months. For touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Canyon corridor, it represents a potential warm-weather refreshment stop.
